@everyone 🇹🇷 NOVEMBER 10 – REMEMBERING ATATÜRK WITH RESPECT, LOVE AND GRATITUDE

Today, we commemorate Gazi Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the founder of the Republic of Türkiye, the architect of our independence, and a great leader, on the anniversary of his passing.

Atatürk was not only an inspiration to the Turkish nation but also a role model for the entire world. Through his vision, leadership, ideas, and reforms, he left an unforgettable mark on history.

He showed the world that a nation could rise again and taught humanity the importance of independence, freedom, and unity.

We will forever protect and carry forward the Republic and the values he entrusted to us.

Although many years have passed, his legacy and ideas will live on forever.

We have not forgotten you, and we never will.

🇹🇷 We remember Gazi Mustafa Kemal Atatürk with deepest respect, love, and gratitude.

November 10, 1938 – Forever in Our Hearts.
